sequences: Every inherited FIT16 and INNER8 video, no density/effect selection
event_rule: First initialized sole-click episode by (click frame, episode UID), first registered event frame with 100 future original frames; never use branch reward or GT-best action to choose
branches: All actual feasible registered arms, including harmful and identical-action controls; retain missing/infeasible reasons
evaluation_window: Current action t and t+1 through t+100, 101 original frames
time_remap: Evaluation-only frame origin remap; public IDs and detections unchanged
